description: CRN_MultiHazard_Kriging_MOEGO is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by Mohsen Shahandashti, University of Texas at Arlington (uta.edu). This project provides a reduced, reproducible case study of a Kriging-surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization framework for proactive rehabilitation planning of concrete road networks (CRNs) exposed to multiple, independently occurring natural hazards. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-k1nm-3b95. Keywords: multi-hazard, rehabilitation planning, concrete road networks, Kriging surrogate model, multi-objective optimization, MO-EGO. Published 2026-09-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
